citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 2:55 pm on
8/25/2026. The inspector contacted the licensee by phone and was notified that there was no responsible adult available
within an hour of the inspector's arrival. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a
violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section

Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries. 
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 2:55 pm on 
8/25/2026. The inspector contacted the licensee by phone and was notified that there was no responsible adult available 
within an hour of the inspector's arrival. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a 
violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action. 
 
 
End Section
